About the Scholarship

AUT's doctoral scholarships provide competitive support for eligible researchers. Applicants must meet doctoral admission requirements as well as the scholarship criteria, and should allow time to complete both processes before the November consideration deadline. Auckland University of Technology (AUT) invites applications for a PhD position in this area: AUT Doctoral Scholarships 2026/27. The work sits within All Subjects. Location: Auckland, New Zealand. Full funding is provided; financial support is listed as NZD 34,737/year (2026 rate), plus tuition. Applications close 1 November 2026.

Research Areas

  • Eligible AUT doctoral subjects
  • Research training
  • Doctoral study

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 34,737/year (2026 rate), plus tuition
DurationNormally three years

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsNormally three years; doctoral admission and scholarship requirements both apply.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026
LocationNew Zealand

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.aut.ac.nz/study/fees-and-scholarships/scholarships-and-awards-at-aut/doctoral-scholarships

Source: aut.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

  1. Review the scholarship conditions alongside the doctoral programme’s admission requirements.
  2. Complete the admission, scholarship or nomination steps specified by the host; do not assume one submission covers every stage.
  3. Submit by the deadline for your applicant category, or follow the stated consideration round where applications are rolling.

About Auckland University of Technology (AUT)

AUT offers research degrees across its faculties in Auckland. Its Graduate Research School supports doctoral researchers, and competitive university scholarships help eligible candidates with living costs and tuition.
